text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A field experiment found remote working generally increased job performance, especially for mothers.","cited_pids":["ef88116f982d#1"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A Saudi financial-sector study found remote work raised productivity through job satisfaction and work-life balance.","cited_pids":["d3dba06e800d#2"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A meta-analysis summary reports a median productivity gain of +10% for focused tasks and -4% for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A randomized trial of hybrid schedules found no measurable productivity difference between remote workers and in-office peers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A managers' experiment found that a two-day hybrid schedule does not damage performance.","cited_pids":["a5a6c6342091#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A panel survey of 3,123 office workers found full-remote work (five days a week) was associated with reduced work productivity and increased presenteeism.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"In the same panel survey, partial remote work reduced stress.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Aggregate BLS material on remote work and productivity gives no clear conclusion in the passage shown.","cited_pids":["8301af91d994#0"]}]}
